title: GraceEvent
description:
The complete backend -> frontend event contract. This is the ONE seam between the Grace backend (Python today, Rust after the migration) and the React renderer. It is FROZEN: additive-only, and only for genuinely new UI features. If a port cannot reproduce an existing event at the right moment, that is a bug in the port, not a reason to change this file.

Source of truth for: frontend/renderer/src/state/types.ts (generated), the Rust grace-proto event enum (generated), and the runtime validating tap in src/grace/ws_server.py.

Idle.description: Turn is over; the overlay resets to its resting state. Emitted at main.py:586,593,738.

WakeWordDetected.description: Vosk matched the wake word, or the UI/global-hotkey forced a wake. main.py:531.

ListeningStarted.description: Mic is open for the primary utterance of a turn. main.py:534.

FollowupListeningStarted.description: The post-response follow-up window has opened. main.py:697. `timeout` is the window length in whole seconds (config.followup_timeout_seconds, default 10).

FinalTranscript.description: Whisper's transcript for the utterance just captured. main.py:597,743. Grace has no partial/streaming transcript: Whisper runs once on the whole buffered utterance after VAD closes the turn.

ListeningStopped.description: Mic closed for this utterance. main.py:598.

UnderstandingStarted.description: Intent inference began. main.py:607. `label` is user-facing prose, e.g. "Understanding request…".

UnderstandingFinished.description: Intent inference ended (success or failure). main.py:617,635.

ToolExecutionStarted.description: A tool is about to run. `label` is the only field the renderer consumes; `tool` and `step` are emitted by the agent loop (loop.py:211) for tracing and are absent on the fast-path dispatcher's emissions (dispatcher.py:182,209).

ToolExecutionFinished.description: The tool finished. `tool` and `status` are emitted by the agent loop (loop.py:237) and absent from the dispatcher's emission (dispatcher.py:186).

ResponseChunk.description: One sentence-shaped slice of the assistant's response, split off the LLM token stream as it arrives (response/generator.py:127,142,218). The renderer CONCATENATES these; the leading-space rule (" " prefix for i > 0) lives on the emitting side, so chunk boundaries are part of the contract, not an implementation detail.

SpeechStarted.description: TTS playback began for this response. generator.py:95,190.

SpeechChunk.description: One synthesized sentence was handed to the player. Paired 1:1 with ResponseChunk. generator.py:128,143,219.

ConversationFinished.description: The turn's work is done; the follow-up window may still be open. main.py:585,591,603,682.

TurnTrace.description: Per-turn latency instrumentation. main.py:520. Diagnostic only - the renderer ignores it. Shape is util/timing.py TurnTrace.to_dict().

Error.description: A turn failed in a way the user must be told about. RESERVED: the Python backend never emits this today (it logs and falls through to ConversationFinished + Idle). The renderer has always handled it, and the Rust port needs it for sidecar-unavailable and supervisor-failure paths, so it stays in the contract. Emitting it from Python would be a behavior change and is out of scope for the migration.
